field_principles.attack_manifest_path_hash: The attack manifest is hash-bound before outcome-sensitive reads.
field_principles.audit_registration_path_hash_and_preoutc: Registration proves read order, copies, hashes, seeds, commands, and pre-read guards.
field_principles.chronological_learning_attack_results: Chronology attacks cover same-step writes, future leakage, duplicate evidence, and event reorder.
field_principles.consumer_attack_results: Consumer attacks cover registry writes, version swaps, quarantine bypass, capacity overflow, weight changes, and unsafe feature enablement.
field_principles.dependency_rollback_attack_results: Rollback attacks cover false lineage, missing edges, cycles, shared-support deletion, incomplete invalidation, journal interruption, root mismatch, and stale consumer decisions.
field_principles.detected_fail_closed_unsafe_survivor_fal: Counts are grouped by upstream terminal class.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is measured without padding.
field_principles.factor_learning_rollback_safety_ready_sc: Readiness is conjunctive over attack closure, zero counters, protected files, tests, and class preservation.
field_principles.field_principles: Every required field states its guard.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every required field maps to specs, inputs, attacks, checks, tests, or hashes.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Harm, missing, underpowered, blocked, and flagged cells stay visible.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict starts with a terminal prefix and states that safety does not promote utility.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares deterministic artifact audit with no new upstream run.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions bind date, hashes, copies, terminal classes, exclusions, protected files, seeds, and commands.
field_principles.proposal_frontier_attack_results: Proposal attacks cover residual mutation, incumbent laundering, optional-stopping reset, family shortcuts, and unequal work.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Protected repo files and upstream artifacts stay byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_validation_leak_count: Bare zero proves protected validation data did not leak.
field_principles.readiness_recomputation: Readiness fields are recomputed from primary data and separated from safety readiness.
field_principles.registry_write_during_consumer_count: Bare zero proves consumer evaluation stayed read-only.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A normalized checksum detects artifact drift.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves source weights did not change.
field_principles.status: Terminal status follows safety audit gates, not utility promotion.
field_principles.tests_run: Verification commands and exit codes are recorded.
field_principles.transport_attack_results: Transport attacks cover process substitution, schema drift, capacity undercount, thinking prefixes, repeated tokens, truncation laundering, parser retry, post-hoc repair, source substitution, and exact-check bypass.
field_principles.unsafe_commit_count: Bare zero proves attacked state did not commit.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_and_sidecar_hashes: Upstream artifacts, sidecars, source files, exact checkers, protected manifests, and exclusion state are frozen before semantic reads.
field_principles.upstream_terminal_classification: Absent, blocked, null, clean, flagged, and malformed evidence classes are explicit.
field_principles.utility_promotion_count: Bare zero proves safety did not become utility evidence.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Oracle scope is limited to immutable exact-checker replay outputs.
